about: Better Beef Smashburgers is a smashburger food truck in College Station.

It was launched by a 16-year-old, home-schooled entrepreneur who always wanted to run his own business like his parents, and KXXV covered its grand opening. It has served at The Ranch Harley-Davidson and Four Downs Sports Bar.
It holds a perfect 5.0 stars on Google.
